conclusion: Small MLP is parameter-efficient and has English loss close to independent LoRA, but rewriting remains meaning-unstable. Output-only alternatives have not established an overall improvement.
limitations: Two-LR head search vs earlier single-LR LoRA, and backbone dropout differs. Complete recipes compared, not isolated causal effect.
Development repeatedly reused; assistant review is not human gold or an unbiased accuracy estimate.
